value.drug_or_class: Antacids (Mg/Al Hydroxide) and Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPIs)
value.effect: Antacids and PPIs decrease mycophenolate mofetil dissolution and gastrointestinal absorption, significantly reducing systemic exposure and immunosuppressive efficacy.
value.management: Separate administration of antacids by at least 2 hours; evaluate the clinical necessity of PPIs or consider switching to H2-receptor antagonists if exposure is compromised.
